text: Iran Attacks Saudi Arabia LIVE: 4 BALLISTIC Missiles BLOW Oil Facility in Riyadh | Trump FURIOUSFootage captures a tense moment as multiple ballistic missiles are launched toward Riyadh amid escalating Iran-Saudi tensions. Saudi air defenses reportedly intercepted four incoming missiles, debris landed near a key refinery, triggering explosions and panic. The strike follows wider attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure, raising fears of a broader regional conflict and global oil disruption.
